space cruiser!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|audio=Solo-Icecube.flac|}} '''Hoth''' was the sixth [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of the remote [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. A desolate world covered with [[Water/Legends|ice]] and snow, located in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]], a rarely-traveled portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], it became famous as the one-time location of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The base was discovered by the Empire in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], precipitating the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], a major engagement during which the Rebels suffered heavy casualties and lost Echo Base. ==Description== {{Quote|But sir, the Hoth system is supposed to be devoid of human forms.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]]|}} [[File:Hoth_volcanoes.png|thumb|left|250px|Volcanic activity on Hoth during the Cold War]] Located on the fringe of the [[Ivax Nebula/Legends|Ivax Nebula]] in the [[Anoat sector/Legends|Anoat sector]] of the [[Greater Javin/Legends|Greater Javin]], Hoth [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the blue-white [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Hoth (star)/Legends|Hoth]] on a wide elliptical orbit. Beyond Hoth was voluminous band of [[Asteroid/Legends|planetesimals]], known as the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]], from which small asteroids regularly broke off, crashing onto Hoth's surface as [[Meteorite/Legends|meteorites]]. The planet was the sixth in the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]].[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]] [[File:Tauntauncave-woswfg.jpg|thumb|A lush glacial cave populated by different species of tauntauns.|left|267x267px]] The planet's surface was entirely covered by a frozen [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]], except where [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] fissures opened up steam vents, depositing rock and [[Mineral/Legends|minerals]] in darker patches on the glacier plains. A few [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] ranges pierced the permanent ice shelves, some being geologically active. The tidal pull of Hoth's three nameless [[Moon/Legends|moons]] caused fissures in the ice-layers, sending jets of ocean water into the freezing Hoth air. The intense cold froze these jets into spires of ice, suspending primitive ocean [[Algae/Legends|algae]] within these tall columns and glaciers. Massive oceanic currents beneath the southern hemisphere caused regular seismic activity, resulting in a constantly shifting landscape of caves and tunnels. Buried deep in Hoth's equatorial region was a fissure, reaching hundreds of meters towards the core of the planet. In this area never exposed to Hoth's blue-white sun was a cache of [[lumni-spice]], a rare fungal growth. At some locations, lush glacial caves with floors covered by [[Lichen/Legends|lichen]] existed that provided food and shelter for herds of diferent species of [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]]. Its orbit and axial tilt resulted in consistently icy weather patterns. Daytime temperatures reached levels unbearable to most species and rarely rose above freezing, even in the planet's relatively mild equatorial regions. The gale force winds and intense snowstorms that regularly wracked the windswept surface magnified the extreme cold of Hoth. The average planetary temperature was around -61[[Standard (temperature)|ºC]]; however, at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]], located near the planet's equator in the northern hemisphere, daytime temperatures could reach -32ºC; however, night-time temperatures got as low as -60ºC. The frigid biosphere included a minimal food chain: the predatory [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]], the omnivorous tauntauns, the herbivorous [[Hoth hog/Legends|Hoth hogs]], a few [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]] species, including [[Snowmouse|snowmice]] and [[Ice scrabbler/Legends|ice scrabblers]], and [[Iceworm/Legends|iceworms]], lichens, and [[Dragon slug]]s. ==History== ===Infinite Empire=== Hoth appears to have been part of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in a long forgotten past as evidenced by the existence of Rakatan steles on the ice planet. Indeed during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a [[The Barsen'thor|Jedi Consular]] looking for the prison of the [[Esh-kha]], discovered in a cave an holographic artifact designed by Rakatas who provided the coordinates of the planet [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. ===Old Republic=== [[File:SithGravesHoth-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|Ancient Sith Sarcophagi |267x267px]] Dark Lord [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] constructed a temple on Hoth, among several other planets. [[Sith sarcophagus|Sarcophaguses]] and statues from his period survived up until the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], when a group of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] established an encampment in the sith ruins, to investigate its remains. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vujaar]], of the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], dispatched agents to kill the jedi and their Republic commando guard, to secure artifacts for the Empire. The findings surprised him, revealing that Naga Sadow's legacy on Hoth had been largely forgotten.{{TORcite|type=heroic|The Big Find|Hoth}} To the wider galaxy, Hoth's existence was known as early as [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]] During the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] suffered a [[Battle of Hoth (Great Galactic War)|major defeat]] at the hands of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] in orbit of Hoth; the two fleets included some of the most advanced warships available, and the Republic lost several valuable prototype vessels in the engagement. The battle showered the planet's surface with hundreds of shipwrecks, but neither side possessed the resources to recover them. At the same time, a group of [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolans]] tried to colonize the planet, building thermal power stations in order to better survive the harsh environmental conditions of the icy world. By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], pirates established a major presence on Hoth, to salvage the wreckage left by the war, but their efforts were contested with the onset of competing efforts by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The main pirate gang was the [[White Maw]]. Despite attempts to banish pirates off the planet, the [[Galactic War]] and the following [[Eternal Empire conquest|Zakuul War]] considerably loosened galactic superpowers' attention to Hoth, and the White Maw managed to regain its strength on the planet.{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=other|Alliance Alert: "Little Boss"}} Hoth again became a battlefield in the [[New Sith Wars]], During that conflict, a [[Battle of Hoth (New Sith Wars)|battle]] occurred between [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] forces on the ice world. Prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], Hoth was the location of the [[Ceyan Range Raceway]] [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] course.{{SWArchive|url=play/online-games/racer-rush|text=Racer Rush|int=Racer Rush}} ===Galactic Civil War=== {{Quote|But a settler would have to be crazy to stake his claims on Hoth. This planet doesn't have a thing to offer anyone—except ''us''.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back'' novel]]}} [[File:Luke_discovers_hoth.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crashes on Hoth and rediscovers the planet.]] The planet was not entirely unknown to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] at large. The [[trans-system data storage library]] on the planet [[Halowan]] contained a substantial amount of information concerning the Hoth [[Star system/Legends|system]] and the planet's geography. While still relatively unknown, the planet was a destination for [[ice-boarding]] and [[hover-skiing]] enthusiasts, who could visit Hoth traveling with [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]].{{Disney|url=star-tours-adventures/hoth|text=Star Tours Adventures: Destinations - Hoth|nolive=1}} Hoth was occasionally visited by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] who took advantage of its remote location, using the ice planet as a base. Even prior to his inclusion with the Rebellion, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] was already familiar with Hoth from his days as a smuggler. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] smuggler [[Salmakk]] and his crew used one of Hoth's ice caverns as a base for several years prior to the Alliance's presence there. He and his group were chased away from Hoth by Solo after failing to capture him, hoping to collect the bounty placed on his head by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].[[Star Wars 3-D 2|''Star Wars 3-D'' 2]] The smuggler [[Raskar]], leader of the [[Iridium Pirates/Legends|Pirates of Iridium]], attempted to seize a valuable cache of lumni-spice before the Alliance settled on Hoth, but was chased off by a dragon slug. A group of failed [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attempted to start a hunting business there, but were all supposedly killed by a group of wampas.''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'' Around the time of the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Tatooine]] and the destruction of the [[Anchorhead Base]], a small team of Rebels established [[Gamma Base]] on Hoth, joined by [[Rookie One]]. However, the location was discovered by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] employing [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droids]]. This resulted in a [[Battle of Hoth (0 BBY)|battle]] involving [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] and [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 airspeeders]] in a remarkable foreshadowing of events to come at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] three years later. The Rebels fought valiantly but eventually had to evacuate the base and the planet. Joining up with [[Ru Murleen]]'s group, Rookie One fought waves of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] until they safely jumped out of the [[Hoth system/Legends|system]] for [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]].''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]''
[[File:Hoth_Operations.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Rebel snowspeeders exit Echo Base on Hoth.]]
After a [[Battle at the Iron Tower|mission]] on [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]] during the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]], [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] with [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] made a daring escape through the Imperial blockade of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], plunging his [[Rebel smuggling ship|ship]] into the vapor-trail of a transdimensional cometary body. His starship was caught in the hyperstream of the comet, and was dragged to the Hoth system. Skywalker was saved from certain death after being trapped in a Hoth blizzard by a young woman named [[Frija Torlock (droid)|Frija Torlock]]. Skywalker was given sanctuary by the woman's father, [[Lexhannen Torlock (droid)|Lexhannen Torlock]], an Imperial [[Governor/Legends|governor]]. However, he soon learned that the two were in actuality [[human replica droid]]s of the real Torlocks, hiding from the Empire on Hoth. Fearful of organic beings, the elder Torlock intended to kill Skywalker. However, in the attempt, he accidentally shot and destroyed his daughter. He was then cut down by the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Skywalker and C-3PO managed to escape the planet after sending a transmission, answered by Han Solo aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. He later recommended Hoth to [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] as a possible relocation site."[[Iceworld]]" The Rebellion's first official involvement on Hoth came in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] when Alliance High Command agreed to use the planet as their headquarters. The [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]], under the command of [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]] and supervised by Major [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]], descended on the ice planet to begin construction of High Command's new base of operations. Monnon's engineers took over the remains of the caverns once used by Salmakk for his smuggling operation, expanding the facilities considerably. The base was built in the northern hemisphere on the only livable temperate band near the equator. Construction on the new [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] was completed in [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]]. Aside from its remote location and near unbearable temperatures making it an unlikely candidate for Imperial probing, Hoth was an ideal location because of the asteroid belt that surrounded the system, providing a difficult barrier for approaching ships. The Rebellion operated out of Echo Base for about one year before it was discovered by the Empire in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. An [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]], launched to Hoth from the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Stalker/Legends|Stalker]]'', attached to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], reported the location of the base to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. Vader and his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] soon arrived in Hoth's orbit, deploying a large invasion force to the planet's surface. The [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] ensued between the two forces, resulting in a crushing Rebel defeat. Those Rebels lucky enough to survive the battle evacuated the planet. The debris of the battlefield attracted the scavenger [[Arns Grimraker]].[[Star Wars (1977) 78|''Star Wars'' (1977) 78]] [[File:Battle_of_Hoth.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The advancing line of [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].]] During the battle, a group of eighteen Rebels deemed most valuable to the Alliance's cause jettisoned from the disabled [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] [[Bright Hope/Legends|''Bright Hope'']] back to Hoth's surface aboard an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]]. They were forced to survive on Hoth for more than a month before a rescue party led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]] was dispatched to recover them.{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}} The Empire captured numerous wampas and from their base stock bioengineered the [[cliff wampa]]s which the Imperials used to guard their facilities on [[Gall/Legends|Gall]].[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]] An [[Imperial Correctional Center]] was established on the planet, which became known for its harsh conditions; it was said no inmate survived more than three years there before freezing to death. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Rajah Ubooki|imposter of Kadann]] sentenced [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Dunhausen]] to four years imprisonment at the Center. By [[4 ABY/Legends|4.3 ABY]], the interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] had planned for a family getaway vacation deal to Hoth.[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jaden Korr]] later [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|located]] an [[Empire Reborn]] base on the planet.''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]'' In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]] Luke Skywalker and [[Callista Ming]] visited the planet to attempt to regain Callista's [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers. They encountered a group of smugglers who were hunting [[Wampa/Legends|wampas]] for their valuable pelts. Luke happened to come across [[One-Arm]], the wampa that captured him prior to the Battle of Hoth. The two Jedi barely escaped from the savage wampas.[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']] Due to overhunting, both the [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] and the wampa became endangered. Under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]], the [[Galactic Alliance Senate|Senate]] passed legislation protecting the wampa. Similar legislation was proposed for the tauntauns. ==Behind the scenes== [[File:Hoth-shield-gen-mcquarrie.jpg|thumb|250px|Concept art of Hoth by [[Ralph McQuarrie]]|left]] The real-world locations for Hoth are in [[Finse]], Norway. [[File:Hoth_TEA.jpg|thumb|200px|Hoth in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'']] Several sources mention tundras on Hoth. However, one has never been depicted. Most depictions are of icy plains with no vegetation whatsoever. Tundras have many varieties of low vegetation such as [[Grass/Legends|grasses]]. ===Discrepancies=== Hoth also appeared in the Japanese [[Star Wars (1987 video game)|''Star Wars'' 1987 video game]], although there was some debate as to whether the planet was intended to be Hoth. In addition, some unofficial translations to the game, as well as the Katakana for the planet, referred to the planet as "'''Tina'''." In an email, [[Jason Fry]] stated that they generally treat the planet as if it were Hoth.{{EmailCite|email=File:JasonFryEmail-20120709.png|creator=[[Jason Fry]]|date=2012-07-09}} The PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places Hoth in the [[Churba sector/Legends|Churba sector]], which is actually located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
